inventory_method: Searched the complete official Node.js v26.10.0 API documentation (all.json) for DOMParser, XMLSerializer, XMLHttpRequest, and the word XML; the only XML mention is the node:test junit reporter, which writes XML test reports and does not parse XML. In the pinned node image (same base_image digest as the project), typeof DOMParser, XMLSerializer and XMLHttpRequest are 'undefined' and require('module').builtinModules contains no XML, SAX or DOM module.

non_parser_mentions.reason: Emits jUnit XML test results; writer only.

note: Node.js 26.10.0 core has no XML parser API. Browser DOMParser is a documented web runtime API and is already inventoried for the SVG cell, but it has not been rerun on either XML pilot control or given an XML-specific receipt here. The zero count describes verified XML APIs in this pilot, not absence of browser XML parsing. Node packages such as jsdom (delegating to saxes) and @xmldom/xmldom remain third-party leads.
